answer: Every identity is born with a birth certificate stamped by the epoch beacon, and standing grows only with age: each epoch the beacon issues one saffron maturity seal per identity, but only to those who completed verified service that epoch. A seal expires unless renewed, so standing demands continuous real work. The relic archive of an identity - its witnessed deliveries and audits - cannot be fast-forwarded or bought. An attacker spawning a hundred clones gets a hundred newborns; maturing them all costs a hundred identities' worth of genuine service, with no shortcut money can buy.
